reference.title: Hand-drawn text animation, the long way and the short way (red table)
reference.notes: A red paper table with cut-out stickers and boiling marker labels, design-tool type cards, one tall condensed serif word with an eye for a dot, flipbook numbers, an iPad on the table, a plugin panel, condensed italic serif captions. Clone (ishaan-motion, library sfx where the reference has none): data/refs/r4/clone-motion. Blind judge 6.6 vs the R3 bar's 6.4 in the same round.

parts.name: Red paper table
parts.about: a top-down red paper table with fibre grain and a warm top-left light, drifting slowly: the ground every sticker and prop lands on

parts.name: Cut-out sticker drop
parts.about: a paper cut-out with a white border slides in from the side, tilts, presses down on its word (scale 0.98) and settles, its cast shadow tightening as it lands

parts.name: Boiling marker words
parts.about: hand-drawn marker capitals that draw on letter by letter, boil on twos (12 fps jitter) while they hold, then scribble out; tilted, fitted to a max width

parts.name: Word in a design-tool selection box
parts.about: a heavy word on a white card inside a dashed selection box whose corner handles drag it from 55% to full size, the box fading once it lands

parts.name: Tall serif word with an eye for a dot
parts.about: one italic serif word stretched tall (0.78 x 2.02) to fill most of the frame between two dashed guide lines; its i is dotless and a blinking eye sits where the dot would be

parts.name: Flipbook numbers
parts.about: big condensed serif numbers that count up like flipbook pages (the previous page skews underneath), each with a thin condensed label, on a vertical dashed guide

parts.name: Tablet on the table
parts.about: a tablet lies on the table with a pencil beside it; its screen steps through app screens (new file, frame rate, library, canvas) on the spoken words

params.needsAsset: a real screen recording beats the drawn screens

parts.name: Skeuomorphic plugin panel
parts.about: a tall cream hardware-like panel: a dark knob with dial ticks, two side faders, a text field, two D-pads, preset keys, two labelled faders, a row of LED keys and an orange ANIMATE key; two letter tiles stick on beside it

parts.name: Black brush card
parts.about: a black card where a brush stroke paints itself across while a cursor hand presses

parts.name: Boiling hand label
parts.about: a short hand-written label next to a prop that boils on twos

parts.name: Tall condensed italic serif captions
parts.about: 1-3 word chunks (<= 18 chars, breaking before and/but) in an italic serif scaled 0.74 x 1.12, white with a soft shadow, each word on its stamp; under any card that would collide
